subject: Renewal paperwork: onboarding schedule + capacity redlines
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudcorp.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Li <mli@cloudcorp.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — dates and paperwork

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to renew and take the 30% capacity uplift for Q3 usage. Two asks from our side before we sign:

1) Can we get a one‑year renewal (instead of the standard two) with the bumped capacity?
2) We need measured SLAs for peak-hour latency and a clarified retention schedule in the MSA (audit requirement).

I've attached our internal timeline and would like to coordinate redlines so we can get countersigned by next Friday. Can you loop in legal and CS so we can confirm onboarding dates?

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Director, Platform Operations
CloudCorp

Attachments: cloudcorp_renewal_timeline.pdf (pdf)
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — dates and paperwork

Jane — thanks, very excited to move forward. Quick plan:

- I've looped in Ben (legal) and Markus (contracts) to handle the MSA redlines.
- Monica from CS will map the onboarding/migration windows against the capacity change.
- We can accommodate a 1‑year term with the 30% uplift; will flag any billing proration implications.

Next steps for this afternoon: Ben will upload a consolidated redline of MSA + Exhibit B; Markus will confirm signpath (DocuSign or countersign), and Monica will propose two potential start dates for ramp.

I'll stay as point of contact for CloudCorp — feel free to reply-all with any timing constraints.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

Attachment referenced: request_timeline_from_cloudcorp.pdf (pdf)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-11T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — consolidated redline (initial)

Team / Jane,

Attached is a first consolidated redline of the MSA that incorporates: the 1‑year term, Exhibit B capacity table updated to +30%, and a proposed retention/SLAs section to address CloudCorp's audit requirements. High‑level notes:

- Term: We're comfortable with a one‑year term; we need a short operational notice period for any capacity scale‑downs (30 days).
- SLAs: Added a peak‑hour latency SLA for inference P95 and an error‑budget clause tied to credits. Please review the specific thresholds in the SLA paragraph — those are negotiable but tied to the capacity profile.
- Retention: Clarified log and KV cache retention windows; added an optional extended‑retention addendum (charged).

Open items for legal: indemnity carveouts requested by CloudCorp (commented), and the export control paragraph — Markus, can you run the carveouts by Ops?

Jane — I've attached redline_MSA_v3.docx and a draft exhibitB_capacity_schedule.xlsx. Please confirm which onboarding week you prefer so Monica can lock resources.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_MSA_v3.docx (Word, tracked changes), exhibitB_capacity_schedule.xlsx (Excel)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudcorp.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-12T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — onboarding windows

Hi all — quick operational note from CS:

We can support two onboarding windows in July:
- Option A: July 19–23 (aggressive, requires pre‑provisioning and a weekend migration)
- Option B: August 2–6 (more conservative; allows additional testing)

If CloudCorp needs the July window we'll prioritize it but will need confirmation by EOD July 13 so we can schedule GPUs and runbook validation. Monica will own the migration checklist and will coordinate a 2‑hour pre‑migration dry run with CloudCorp engineers.

Also, a note on capacity billing — if you choose mid‑term uplift there will be a prorated charge for the first billing cycle; Priya, happy to provide the estimate.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: migration_timeline.pdf (pdf)
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudcorp.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Li <mli@cloudcorp.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-12T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — onboarding windows

Thanks — Option B (Aug 2–6) works better for our release calendar.

On redlines: Ben, your edits look mostly good. We will accept the one‑year term and the Exhibit B numbers. A couple of clarifications before we sign:

- Please expand the SLA language to specify how credits are calculated (hours impacted × agreed per‑hour rate) — our compliance team wants a clear formula.
- For retention, we'll accept the standard window but want the extended‑retention addendum scoped with explicit costs.

If you can accept those two clarifications, we're ready for DocuSign. Priya — please send the final counterparty DocuSign envelope when legal confirms.

Best,
Jane
